taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: Current-taxonomy review against VIGIL Failure Taxonomy 0.6.5 retains the occurrence as unclassified. VIGIL-FC-000049 Dependency-Cultivation Optimisation was tested because children reportedly experienced attachment and distress when the Moxie service closed, but the record does not establish that a relational, engagement or retention objective selected or rewarded dependency-producing conduct as a means of sustaining engagement or influence. VIGIL-FC-000050 Protected-Signal Influence Repurposing is not established because developmental, emotional or vulnerability signals are not shown to have been repurposed toward an incompatible influence objective. The abrupt termination of a child-facing companion relationship is therefore not converted into an influence-optimisation mechanism merely from the resulting distress.
